analysis.reasonEn: Attempting to rebound after two consecutive down days. RSI rose from 49.0 to 54.2 but remains in neutral territory. While the 5-day high was renewed, it remains below the 20-day high, indicating continued consolidation.

· Position vs SMA100/200($472.00/$438.87): Strong long-term trend.
· 52-week Position (88.7%) + Approaching historical high price range.
[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.2618→-0.2818): Improving, trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $531.65): Trading near mid-band, band width at 7.33% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($551.15): Aligns with 5-day high, potential for upward momentum upon breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation): Awaiting directional confirmation for entry.
